# Catacombes de Paris

> > Official website for the Paris Catacombs, a historic underground ossuary and museum operated by Paris Musées

The Paris Catacombs are located at Place Denfert-Rochereau and Avenue René-Coty in the 14th arrondissement. This underground site features remains transferred from Parisian cemeteries in the late 18th century and offers guided tours, educational programs, and special exhibitions exploring the geological and historical heritage of the Bassin parisien quarries.

## Visit Planning & Tickets

- [Para leer antes de venir](https://www.catacombes.paris.fr/es/visitar/para-leer-antes-de-venir): Pre-visit rules & practical info for Avenue René-Coty entrance
- [Tarifas para grupos](https://www.catacombes.paris.fr/es/visitar/tarifas-para-grupos): Group rates & guided tour pricing for Paris Catacombs visits
- [En famille](https://www.catacombes.paris.fr/en-famille): Family visit guide with practical info & booking at place Denfert-Rochereau
- [En situation de handicap](https://www.catacombes.paris.fr/en-situation-de-handicap): Accessibility info & virtual tour options for visitors with disabilities

## Educational Resources

- [A teacher or monitor](https://www.catacombes.paris.fr/en/teacher-or-monitor): Educational group visit resources & booking info for teachers
- [Enseignant ou animateur](https://www.catacombes.paris.fr/enseignant-ou-animateur): Teacher resources with pedagogical materials & group reservations
- [Atelier Enfant (5 à 12 ans) : À la découverte des fossiles](https://www.catacombes.paris.fr/decouvrir/agenda/atelier-enfant-5-12-ans-la-decouverte-des-fossiles): Children's fossil discovery workshop (ages 5-12) at Paris Catacombs

## Exhibitions & Events

- [The Dead of the French Revolution](https://www.catacombes.paris.fr/en/discover/exhibition/dead-french-revolution): Exhibition on French Revolution figures including Robespierre
- [Printemps des cimetières](https://www.catacombes.paris.fr/decouvrir/agenda/printemps-des-cimetieres-0): Free stone engraving workshop event at Avenue René-Coty

## About & Services

- [Las Catacumbas (Spanish homepage)](https://www.catacombes.paris.fr/es): Spanish homepage for Paris Catacombs with tickets & visitor info
- [Un museo de la Villa de París](https://www.catacombes.paris.fr/es/un-museo-de-la-villa-de-paris): About Paris Musées municipal museum network & cultural heritage
- [Private events and Film](https://www.catacombes.paris.fr/en/private-events-and-film): Private tours, filming permits & event venue booking information
